in_sanskrit.name: इन्द्रक्षी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Indrakshi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Indra' (God of rain and thunder) and 'Akshi' (protection or sight). This name is believed to offer the protection of the God Indra to the child.

in_hindi.name: इन्द्रक्षी
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम इंद्रक्षी संस्कृत शब्दों 'इन्द्र' (मेघ और वर्षा के देव) और 'अक्षी' (रक्षा या दृष्टि) से स्थापित है। यह नाम प्रास्तुत देव इंद्र के साथ सही रहने वाले प्रकार को देने वाले नाम है।

in_tamil.name: இந்திரக்ஷீ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Indrakshi is derived from the words 'Indira' (Indra) and 'Kshi' (protection). This name signifies the protection offered by Indra, the rain god.

in_telugu.name: ఇంద్రక్షీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Indrakshi is derived from the words 'Indra' (Indra) and 'Kshi' (protection). This name signifies the one who is protected by Indra, the rain god.

in_marathi.name: Indrakshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Indrani's Crown
in_marathi.long_meaning: Indrakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Indrakshi is a beautiful and unique Hindu name for girls, derived from the Sanskrit language. The name signifies the divine crown worn by Goddess Indrani, the queen of the rain god Indra. This name is rooted in Hindu mythology and holds deep spiritual significance.
